equity.level_reason: Age and sex describe the case series (median age 80 years, 79% men), and age is offered only as a clinical explanation for the case fatality rate; no other SPD appears.

level_alternative.reason: Older age and being trapped in homes could be read as vulnerability in a disaster, but the article does not frame them as social position.

notes: The expected count is the 5-year median for the same weeks, an arithmetic baseline rather than a statistical procedure. Comparisons with Hurricanes Irma and Katrina use counts cited from earlier reports.
view_issues: Text says three expected cases for weeks 40–41 and 38 observed, yet calls this an 1,100% increase; 38 vs 3 is about 1,170%, so the figure appears rounded or based on a different baseline. CFR given as 28.9% and deaths as 29%.
